title: Sovereign Server Deployment | ContextMint Docs
description: Deploy ContextMint as a shared on-prem API with OpenAI-compatible inference (vLLM), OIDC, and path-aligned workspaces — not the desktop Engine tray.

lead.before: For regulated pilots, platform teams run a
lead.mid2: ), Chroma, Redis, and OIDC. This is
lead.mid3: “Engine + Ollama on every laptop,” and it is
lead.after: dual-plane multi-user (that programme is post-demo). Developers install the VS Code extension only and point it at your HTTPS endpoint.

stories.title: Two deployment stories (do not conflate)

rows.who: Shared host in your DC / tenant
rows.when: Bank / gov design partners needing one audit boundary

stories.opsNote: Operator dogfood and flip checklist: product repo

items.text: — Docker Compose (deploy/docker-compose.server.yml) or equivalent; profile deployment_profile=server
— OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM overlay common); set INFERENCE__OPENAI_COMPAT__BASE_URL
— Chroma on shared storage for MVP; Qdrant is a later scale option
— AUTH__ENABLED=true, OIDC issuer/audience, strong JWT secret, workspace ACL as required
— ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_ROOTS must match mounts or Remote SSH paths the server can read

developers.title: What developers do
developers.step1After: extension only (do not require Engine on every laptop).
steps: Set ContextMint.serverUrl to the team HTTPS API.
Open a workspace the server can index (Remote SSH or matching mount).
